blocks.content: 🚫 Skipped (low yield): Ladakh 23 "Protected Monuments"; XWG Diesel launch details beyond one-liner

items: Dept of Military Medicine inaugurated at Command Hospital, Lucknow — India's 1st dedicated academic/operational military medicine dept.
DAANVEER — Gram Panchayat digital infra initiative (links Meri Panchayat app + DigiHaat).
I4C orders GitHub to remove "Bitchat" — under IT Act Sec 79(3)(b) & IT Rules 2021 Rule 3(1)(d).
Air India Hub-and-Spoke model — currently 1 hub (Delhi) + 2 spokes (Varanasi, Amritsar); targets 44 airports incl. 4 hubs.
Supreme Court interim order bars unauthorised posting/monetising of court-proceeding footage; CJI Surya Kant (53rd), sanctioned strength 38.
Supreme Court extends mandatory 3rd-party vehicle insurance — cars: 4 yrs (from 3); 2-wheelers: 6 yrs (from 5).
Kerala's ANNAM.AI smart weather stations (developed at IIT Ropar); Punjab was 1st implementation state.
HAL Airport Bengaluru — 1st airport with RNP CAT H helicopter approach (approach time cut ~12 min → ~4 min).

Assam — world's 1st release of GSM-GPS-tagged captive-bred Slender-billed Vultures (10 released, Jatayu Aviary, Kaziranga); India's Gyps vulture population fell ~99% in 2 decades (diclofenac; banned 2006). 🎯 🔥 HIGH.
TRAI expands 1600-series to new "1601" series — beyond BFSI to utilities, courier/logistics.
TRAI's revamped MyCall app — 1–5 star call rating, call-drop reporting.
PM Modi launches "Nasha Mukt Yuva for Viksit Bharat Sankalp Abhiyan" — 100-week campaign (MY Bharat, Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports).

MoRTH's two-wheeled road ambulances + V2V mandate — V2V communication mandatory for new L/M/N-category vehicles from **1 Oct 2028** (already-fitted vehicles: 1 Oct 2027); DoT allocated 5.875–5.925 GHz band. 🎯 2027 vs 2028 compliance-date trap.
MCA notifies changes to Ind AS Rules — aligned with OECD Pillar Two; amendments cover Ind AS 101, 107, 109, 110, 7.
Arjun Ram Meghwal launches revamped India Code Portal — laws in all 22 languages (Eighth Schedule).
Govt to remove 12-minute TV ad-duration cap — cap introduced 2006 under Cable Television Networks Rules, 1994.

President Murmu approves 78 gallantry awards (incl. 13 posthumous) — Kirti Chakra: 9 (2nd-highest peacetime gallantry award), Shaurya Chakra: 19 (3rd-highest); Ashoka Chakra = highest (Param Vir Chakra equivalent). 🎯 🔥 HIGH — hierarchy: Ashoka > Kirti > Shaurya.
Gallantry & Service Medals for 1,057 personnel (police/fire/home guard/civil defence/correctional services), Independence Day 2026.
India's first Accreditation Scheme for Mobile Food Testing Labs — NABL (constituent of QCI).
National Biodiversity Authority releases ₹15.52 crore in ABS proceeds from mustard genetic resources — NBA (Est. 2003, HQ Chennai, MoEFCC, implements Biological Diversity Act 2002).
HM Amit Shah launches Gramin Gyan Setu app — coincides with National Library Day (12 Aug, S.R. Ranganathan's birth anniversary).
L&T's Vyoma.AI to build India's largest single-cluster AI infra — Nvidia B300 factory for Together AI (US); order value ₹10,000–15,000 crore, Chennai.
Cyber Kushti 2026 — launched by NIELIT; theme: Cyber Security & AI.
